single.description: 1 句英语，用于打开即用、权限与隔离场景
sentences: Good morning everyone, welcome to our weekly project meeting.

multi.description: 3 句英语，句间停顿 2 秒，用于多句顺序与停止场景
sentences: Good morning everyone, thank you for joining the meeting today.
First, let us review the sales results from the last quarter.
Our revenue grew by twelve percent compared with the same period last year.

meeting.description: 6 句英语（首句为 ≥ 8 秒长句），句间停顿 2 秒，用于流式临时字幕（AC-02）、含义一致（AC-04）与多句不重不漏（AC-05）；每句附参考中文译文、关键要素（每组为可接受写法的正则，全部命中才算含义一致）与唯一锚点
sentences: Good afternoon everyone, today we are going to review the sales report for the third quarter, and after that we will discuss the marketing plan for next year in detail.
The new office in Singapore will open on the fifth of March.
Our team has twelve engineers and four designers.
We will not cancel the project because the budget has been approved.
Please send the final contract to Michael before Friday afternoon.
The price of the product increased by fifteen percent last year.

annotations.reference: 大家下午好，今天我们将审阅第三季度的销售报告，之后我们将详细讨论明年的营销计划。
新加坡的新办公室将于三月五日开业。
我们团队有十二名工程师和四名设计师。
我们不会取消这个项目，因为预算已经获批。
keyPoints: 批准|获批|通过|核准|审批

annotations.reference: 请在周五下午之前把最终合同发给迈克尔。
该产品的价格去年上涨了百分之十五。

long.description: 1 句 10–20 秒的长句，句内只有逗号短停顿，用于断句阈值验证
sentences: Before we move on to the next topic, I would like to remind everyone that the updated budget proposal, which includes the new hiring plan, the marketing campaign for the spring season, and the revised schedule for the product launch, must be reviewed and approved by the end of next week.

interference.description: 2 句与 multi 内容不重合的英语，系统声音场景中由假麦克风同时播放，作为“麦克风/环境声”干扰源；关键要素用于断言字幕中零命中（AC-03）
sentences: My grandmother keeps three cats and a parrot in her garden.
The train to London leaves from platform nine at midnight.

annotations.reference: 我奶奶在她的花园里养了三只猫和一只鹦鹉。
